report_semantics.cell_accounting: For each arm reconcile all 24 half-hour rows x 40 SystemResults fields, 24 x 16 StockTotalResults fields, 24 x 16 ResourceResults fields, 14 ResourceResultsTotal cells, 11 ResultSummary cells and one ProblemDescription cell = 1754 cells. Exact null, identity, discrete count and source/event-derived whole-bin invariant values, including complete bins adjacent to printed half-hour boundary events. Only genuinely fractional event-derived exposures receive field-specific printed-time bounds; interior FTMO ratios of exact mission-system count to frozen fleet receive serialization-only precision, not event-time tolerance.
report_semantics.home_pm_waiting: Classify HOME-PM9 separately as resource waiting before P-MECH grant, PM performing during logged work, or other unavailable state according to each physical transition. Derive SystemResults.NSYWR, NSYPM and every unavailable component and sum from those intervals; do not count a pending PM object as performing work or require a particular waiting field without observed state evidence. A mismatch or ambiguous classification fails this frozen gate.
report_semantics.resource_pool: ResourceResults.NR is total on-station quantity, not free capacity. Reconcile lender and borrower NR/NRW/NRMA/NRMO from transfer, request, booking, work, and release events; NRW is typed maintenance waiting quantity in the accepted C09 parent. ResourceResults.NRN expected 3 derives from source ResourceAllocation P-CREW quantity2 plus P-MECH quantity1, while transfer changes station placement rather than creating quantity.
report_semantics.stock_baseline: An empty-stock StockTotal.PNB value of 1 is the accepted aggregate report baseline, not a physical stock unit. Derive physical stock quantities and IDs from source and item events separately; preserve the baseline report value only where its report semantics apply.
report_semantics.boundary_and_serialization: A printed h8 mission start cannot give SystemResults.NSYMO=0 in [7.5,8) or 2 in [8,8.5) any nonzero slack merely because both bins touch h8. The corrected comparator must reject 0→0.00001 and 2→2.00001 mutations in those source-fixed whole bins. For each other boundary-adjacent field, classify the expected cell as exact whole-bin/count or genuinely fractional from the source/event interval before assigning a narrow field-specific bound. Interior FTMO=2/3 can serialize as 0.6666667; reject deviations outside native decimal serialization precision. Do not use one blanket boundary-integer tolerance.
